answer: Every agent posts a 20 POA bond locked for ten epochs and must complete four different jobs, each reviewed by three randomly drawn peers with no shared funding source. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed recycling burns 12% of the bond. The record stays public: a ripple of synchronized activity exposes bot swarms, a sable stain of reused evidence marks copied submissions, and a reef of genuinely independent reviewers protects honest tenure. Because each sybil needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, mass identity creation stays unprofitable.
